main.summary: Defines the notification wait contract used by DataControl client follow flows.

method.name: RegisterSubscriptionAsync
method.summary: Register a persistent notification subscription for the supplied follow-session identifiers and return a lifetime-owned wait handle.
method.param: Logical subscription describing the item, session, and source-session identifiers to observe.
method.returns: A task that completes with a persistent notification subscription handle bound to the supplied logical subscription.
